_comment: Flat 48: the draft of Flat 47. Everything here is the first build's (story bible 2d: the owner's direction and the master document's Part VI; wording marked PROPOSED there), moved into data. blocks: [collider index in level.json, the word that makes it real ('' = nothing does, yet), the pencilled tag]. words: the loose notes on the hall wall, in order. Socko's lines carry his face cues like every other line.
blocks: the green one with the burn
three pale circles where the plates would go
the good glasses, the television, the doll
two pillows; one side never slept on
the back of it isn't the back of it
a note on the door: what did it say?
smaller; rubbed out and written again
a glass on it, two toothbrushes, one small

mama.name: MARTA
mama.look: At the stove. A paper tag pinned where a heart would be: MAMA — hair up, the blue cardigan.
mama.dressed: A shop mannequin in her cardigan, her hair up, a mouth painted on in her red. Nothing else on the face. It's looking at the stove.
mama.becomes: The note stays, over the heart. A shop mannequin, dressed as her: the blue cardigan, her hair up, her red on a mouth painted where a face should be.

papa.name: KURT
papa.look: At the bedroom window, looking out at the white. Your height, exactly. The tag: PAPA — nights — the jacket. Gone a lot.
papa.dressed: A shop mannequin in a dark jacket, a domino mask on a face that isn't there, a bow and a quiver on its back. It's looking out at the white. It's your height.
papa.becomes: The note stays. A shop mannequin in a dark jacket, a domino mask on the face it hasn't got, a bow on its back. It's your height. It's you. It was always you.

child.look: By the small bed. The tag says CHILD, and it's the only one with a drawing on it: a house with black windows.

refuses.SONYA: It won't stay on. Not on this. She isn't here.

captions.block_tag: A white block, the size of something. On a paper tag, in pencil: “%s”.
captions.block_blank: A white block, the size of something. No tag. Nobody's said what it is.
captions.wont_stay: It won't stay on. Not that.
captions.wont_stay_blank: It won't stay on. Nothing will, on this one. Not yet.
captions.real: The note stays. And it's a %s: it always was.
captions.real_empty: The note stays. And it's a %s: it always was. (There's nothing in it.)
captions.peeled: The note comes away, and it's a white block again, the size of something.
captions.safe_block: A tall narrow block against the wall, steel-cold when you touch it, which a block shouldn't be. The tag: “PAPA'S. Locked. Nobody touches it.”
captions.safe_real: The note holds. Steel, green-grey, two locks, a handle worn bright. A gun safe. Of course it is: the law said a hunting gun lives in one.
captions.safe_open: It isn't locked. Inside, on two pegs, standing on what's left of its stock: a shotgun, sawn off short. The cuts are bright and not quite square.
captions.shotgun: It comes off the pegs into your hand and your hand knows where everything is. The top lever. The fore-end catch. Two triggers.
captions.shells: A paper box of twelve-bore shells, buckshot. Ten left.
captions.undressed: The note comes away. White again, and nobody.

f48_arrive.speaker: socko
f48_arrive.text: Huh. It's 47. Somebody drew it from memory and ran out of crayons.

f48_close2.speaker: socko
f48_close2.text: Don't let them get close enough to surprise you.

f48_looked.speaker: socko
f48_looked.text: You don't know what they are.

f48_looked2.speaker: socko
f48_looked2.text: Mama. Papa. Child. That's supposed to make this better?

f48_notes.speaker: socko
f48_notes.text: Words. We're sticking words on furniture now.

f48_notes2.speaker: socko
f48_notes2.text: I think you're giving this a little too much attention.

f48_real1.speaker: socko
f48_real1.text: Could be someone wanted you to find all this.

f48_real2.speaker: socko
f48_real2.text: You're looking for reasons to trust them.

f48_safe.speaker: socko
f48_safe.text: Ooh. Now that one I like.

f48_opened.speaker: socko
f48_opened.text: Well, would you look at that. Somebody planned ahead.

f48_gun.speaker: socko
f48_gun.text: Two barrels. That's one each for two of them, and a quick reload.

f48_gun2.speaker: socko
f48_gun2.text: I'm just counting. Somebody has to.

f48_shot2.speaker: socko
f48_shot2.text: I knew you'd figure it out.

f48_shot3.speaker: socko
f48_shot3.text: And that's the family. See? Quiet now.

f48_dress_mama.speaker: socko
f48_dress_mama.text: Huh. Look at that. She cleans up.

f48_dress_papa2.speaker: socko
f48_dress_papa2.text: That's not funny. Who's that supposed to be? Don't answer that.

f48_not_sonya.speaker: socko
f48_not_sonya.text: See? Nothing. Nobody's here. Let's go.

f48_refuse1.speaker: socko
f48_refuse1.text: You're making this harder than it needs to be.

f48_refuse2.speaker: socko
f48_refuse2.text: I thought we were trying to get out of here. We have our own problems.

f48_refuse4.speaker: socko
f48_refuse4.text: What? I didn't say shoot them. When did I say shoot them? I said keep your distance.
